stage: Frozen before any FSD waveform/model prediction
dataset: Official FSDnoisy18k v1.0 manually verified test partition
question: Does frozen PANNs LR outperform mean accuracy of three frozen noise-trained CNNs on the mapped external recordings?
eligibility: All official test rows in six mapped classes; exclude Freesound IDs appearing anywhere in the 2000-row ESC50 metadata
audio: Decode full mono waveform; resample_poly to16000Hz; partition consecutive nonoverlapping80000sample windows; zero-pad final fragment; no clipping/peak normalization
aggregation: Softmax over all50 per window; arithmetic mean weighted by actual unpadded sample counts; argmax all50 once per original recording
primary: Clip accuracy PANNs minus mean of3 noiseCNN accuracies, percentage points
secondary: Macro F1 over6 targets, counting outside6 predictions as errors

bootstrap.unit: unique Freesound recording ID, equivalent to row resampling here
bootstrap.scope: Conditional fixed fits, mapped labels and known-recording-ID exclusions; not uploader/pretraining uncertainty

stop: Evaluate once, report all4 systems and all6 classes; no score-driven remapping, trimming, retraining or model selection
limitations: Six-class external subset, not an original20class FSD benchmark or full50class ESC50 benchmark
Clean means manually verified labels, not acoustically noise-free
Freesound-ID disjointness does not rule out reuploads, perceptual duplicates, shared uploaders or AudioSet pretraining exposure
Full-recording window aggregation differs from fixed5s ESC50 protocol; do not attribute score difference solely to distribution shift
